copy.upcoming: A new night sky is approaching. Every crew will begin with the same small fleet.
copy.live: Build a separate fleet and discover how the returning stars change its connections. Your main harbor keeps working.
copy.ended: The public watch has ended. Your fleet and rewards are safe in the archive.
copy.archived: Continue your fleet whenever you like. Your selected pass can still earn XP from the same daily contracts.
copy.pass: Choose one pass for new contract XP. Free rewards and premium appearances use the same 30-level track.
copy.premium: Premium ownership adds ten appearances. It adds no XP, currency, storage or production. Verified purchase restoration is required.
copy.alternative: Assign this daily slot to the seasonal fleet. Complete its frozen production target to claim that same slot once.
copy.archive_resume: Resume your archived fleet from its saved position. Time spent while the archive is paused grants no fleet production.

milestones.title: First Signal
milestones.body: Your fleet has recovered its first shared bearing.

milestones.title: Shared Sky
milestones.body: The observatory and working fleet now read the same sky.

milestones.title: Returning Stars
milestones.body: The seasonal map is ready to join the harbor archive.

rewards.title: The First Empty Sky
rewards.body: For three nights the harbor kept its lanterns lit. On the fourth, a single point of light answered from beyond the reef.

rewards.title: A Different Fleet
rewards.body: Mara ordered a small fleet built from ordinary timber. The old Charts stayed in the archive: this sky would need its own bearings.

rewards.title: Harbor Lantern

rewards.title: The Watch Ledger
rewards.body: The watchkeeper left a blank line for every returning star. No one knew how many lines the book would need.

rewards.title: Shared Bearings
rewards.body: Two crews argued over a heading until they compared their observations. Each had measured a different part of the same current.

rewards.title: Nursery at Dusk
rewards.body: The prisms grew dim before they grew bright. Their keeper called it listening, and asked the crew to wait.

rewards.title: The Second Signal
rewards.body: A second star appeared beside the first. Their light crossed on the water, marking a path no single lantern could reveal.

rewards.title: A Patient Dynamo
rewards.body: The tide wheel turned while the harbor slept. In the morning its quiet work was waiting, with no demand for thanks.

rewards.title: An Unsent Letter
rewards.body: Mara wrote that the night was less empty now. She left the letter open, hoping to add another observation before dawn.

rewards.title: Loom Instructions
rewards.body: The first woven chart looked wrong. Rotated toward the sea, its loose threads matched the currents exactly.

rewards.title: Visitors on the Pier
rewards.body: Children named the lights after boats they remembered. The archivist recorded both the names and the disagreements.

rewards.title: Cloud Cover
rewards.body: Clouds hid the stars for a day. The crew kept working from their saved bearings; uncertainty did not erase what they had learned.

rewards.title: The Long Shift
rewards.body: A returning watchkeeper found the instruments still turning. Her replacement had left tea, a neat log, and no list of missed duties.

rewards.title: Observatory Window
rewards.body: The new dome did not make the stars brighter. It gave everyone a place to look at them together.

rewards.title: Two Useful Routes
rewards.body: The nursery crew and the skiff crew reached the same light by different routes. Both maps earned a place on the wall.

rewards.title: The Quiet Beacon
rewards.body: One beacon shone steadily enough that people stopped mentioning it. The keeper counted that as success.

rewards.title: A Harbor in Reflection
rewards.body: From the outer reef, the lights on the water looked like another harbor. For a moment the crew could imagine returning to either one.

rewards.title: Meteor Mooring

rewards.title: What Came Home
rewards.body: The stars brought no treasure for the warehouses. They brought bearings, stories, and a reason to paint the boats.

rewards.title: Last Live Watch
rewards.body: On the final scheduled night, the keeper closed the public watch book. Its observations remained available to anyone who wanted to try the route.

rewards.title: The Archive Door
rewards.body: Mara placed the seasonal map beside the first restoration chart. Neither was a deadline now. Both were invitations.

rewards.title: A Light Left On
rewards.body: The harbor kept one lantern burning after the festival. Anyone returning late would still be able to find the pier.
